echo_sets.name: Heart of Evil's Purge
echo_sets.note: Her own Aero Tune Strain set. The 5-pc bonus adds damage stats, plus Calamity Effigy's Aero DMG passives when Tune Strain is applied.

echo_sets.name: Sierra Gale
echo_sets.note: A general Aero DMG set. It boosts Aero DMG after her Intro Skill. Weaker than her signature set, but usable.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Glint of Clouds (or Red Spring / Emerald of Genesis) + 5-piece Heart of Evil's Purge in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, with Calamity Effigy in the main slot. Use a Crit 4-cost. Split the 3-costs between one Aero DMG and one ATK%. Use ATK% 1-costs. Aim for 125% Energy Regen.

ranked_weapons.name: Glint of Clouds
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. It gives big Aero DMG buffs that trigger from her Tune Strain, with near-permanent uptime. By far her strongest option.

ranked_weapons.name: Red Spring
ranked_weapons.note: High base ATK and Crit Rate, plus an ATK passive. A strong limited 5-star alternative.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald Sentence
ranked_weapons.note: Crit Rate, plus Heavy Attack DMG amplification on Echo Skill. A usable alternative.

ranked_weapons.name: Emerald of Genesis
ranked_weapons.note: A standard-banner sword. It gives Crit Rate and Energy Regen, plus ATK that stacks on Resonance Skill.

ranked_weapons.name: Lumingloss
ranked_weapons.note: A battle-pass 4-star. ATK%, plus Heavy Attack DMG on Resonance Skill. A good F2P pick.

ranked_weapons.name: Feather Edge
ranked_weapons.note: A battle-pass 4-star. ATK and Crit Rate, plus an ATK and Liberation DMG effect. Usable.

stat_priorities.note: With her signature, run one Aero DMG Bonus piece and one ATK% piece — the signature has lower ATK. Without it, two Aero DMG pieces work.

profile.role_note: An Aero Tune Strain DPS. She stacks Tune Strain Interfered and Mindlock, then hits hard with her Heavy Attack and Liberation. She is much weaker outside Tune Strain teams.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: The top Aero Tune Strain DPS, with an SS overall placement. But she is a high-investment unit. She needs Denia, Lynae, and Mornye to shine, and she struggles in wave-based content. Pull her if you run Tune Strain teams. Otherwise, a more flexible DPS is safer.

members.name: Qingxiao
members.note: Aero Tune Strain carry; stacks Mindlock and nukes with Heavy Attack and Liberation.

members.name: Denia
members.note: Tune Strain mode sub-DPS; Tune Break Boost and team damage buffs.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Best Tune Strain support; Off-Tune Buildup Rate, team damage buffs, and healing.

teams.name: Premium: Qingxiao + Denia + Mornye
teams.rotation: Mornye sets up buffs and healing first. Denia runs her Tune Strain loop, passing ATK and Tune Break Boost along. Then Qingxiao stacks Tune Strain and lets loose in her Heavy Attack and Liberation windows.

members.name: Qingxiao
members.note: Same Aero Tune Strain carry; benefits from Sanhua's fast rotations and Basic Attack DMG buffs.

members.name: Sanhua
members.note: Fast sub-DPS; strong Basic Attack DMG buffs and quick rotations.

members.name: Mornye
members.note: Tune Strain support; Off-Tune Buildup Rate and team damage buffs.

teams.name: Alternative: Qingxiao + Sanhua + Mornye
teams.rotation: Mornye sets up buffs. Sanhua runs a fast buff rotation. Then Qingxiao takes the field for her Tune Strain damage window.

tier_badge.label: Meta-defining
tier_badge.note: SS overall, SS in ToA, and S+ in WhiWa on the current 3.7 tier lists. The top Aero Tune Strain DPS.

sequences.verdict: S0 has the full loop. S2 raises her Mindlock ceiling. Stop at S3 for the Liberation Crit spike. S6 is whales only.

pull_path.why: Full combat loop with the Mindlock debuff game at S0.
Mindlock ceiling rises to 25; hardest hit gets +40%.
Endgame investment; substantial overall damage lift.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Get the signature Glint of Clouds before S1. The weapon alone is fine if you stop before S3.
